python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,sys
db=next(x for x in subprocess.check_output(["docker","ps","--format","{{.Names}}"],text=True).splitlines() if re.search(r"postgres|database|db-[0-9]",x,re.I))
sql="""SELECT t.chat_id,t.message_thread_id,t.title,coalesce(p.state,'absent'),coalesce(p.pinned::text,'null'),coalesce(p.message_id::text,'null')
FROM posting_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p
ON p.chat_id=t.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=t.message_thread_id
WHERE t.chat_id IN(-1002373696859,-1003770334893) AND t.enabled=TRUE
AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND (t.title ILIKE '%チャット%' OR t.title ILIKE '%見せ合い%')
ORDER BY t.chat_id"""
p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec",db,"sh","-c",'psql -qAt -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"',"sh",sql],capture_output=True,text=True)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(190)
rs=[x.split("|") for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
if len(rs)!=2:sys.exit(191)
rs.sort(key=lambda x:int(x[0]))
if rs[0][0]!="-1003770334893" or rs[1][0]!="-1002373696859":sys.exit(192)
def status(x):
 s=x[3]
 return 0 if s=="absent" else 1 if s=="published" and x[4]=="true" and x[5]!="null" else 2 if s=="verified" and x[5]=="null" else 3
# output categorical only
gay,video=rs
if "チャット" in gay[2]:sys.exit(200+status(video)*4+status(gay))
sys.exit(220+status(video)*4+status(gay))
PY
